entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 3 months after the date you arrive in Morocco.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Marruecos.
entry.quote: To enter Morocco, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Moroccan authorities have denied entry to some travellers with damaged passports.
entry.es: Las autoridades marroquíes han negado la entrada a algunos viajeros con pasaportes dañados.
entry.quote: The Moroccan authorities have denied entry to some travellers with damaged passports.

entry.en: Border officials should stamp your passport on entry, and some travellers had trouble leaving without an entry stamp.
entry.es: Los funcionarios fronterizos deben sellar tu pasaporte al entrar, y algunos viajeros tuvieron problemas para salir sin sello de entrada.
entry.quote: Border officials should stamp your passport when you enter Morocco. Some travellers have had difficulties leaving Morocco because their passport did not have an entry stamp.

entry.en: If you come from a polio-affected country, you must have a certificate proving a polio vaccine to enter Morocco.
entry.es: Si vienes de un país afectado por la polio, debes tener un certificado de vacuna contra la polio para entrar a Marruecos.
entry.quote: To enter Morocco, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a polio vaccine if you’re coming from a polio-affected country.

entry.en: You must declare foreign currency worth 100,000 Moroccan dirham or more when entering or leaving the country.
entry.es: Debes declarar divisas por un valor de 100.000 dirhams marroquíes o más al entrar o salir del país.
entry.quote: You must declare foreign currency worth 100,000 Moroccan dirham or more (equal to around £8,000) when you enter or leave the country.

entry.en: It is illegal to send passports by post to or through Morocco.
entry.es: Es ilegal enviar pasaportes por correo a Marruecos o a través de Marruecos.
entry.quote: It is illegal to send passports by post to or through Morocco.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Morocco.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Marruecos.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Morocco.

safety.en: Petty crime is common in tourist areas, especially in medina quarters and on beaches.
safety.es: Los delitos menores son comunes en zonas turísticas, sobre todo en las medinas y en las playas.
safety.quote: Petty crime is common in tourist areas, especially in historical districts (medina quarters) and on beaches.

safety.en: It is common for people posing as official tourist guides to harass tourists.
safety.es: Es común que personas que se hacen pasar por guías turísticos oficiales acosen a los turistas.
safety.quote: It is common for people posing as official tourist guides to harass tourists.

safety.en: Alcoholic drinks containing methanol have caused deaths and serious illness in Morocco.
safety.es: Bebidas alcohólicas con metanol han causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Marruecos.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Morocco.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual relations are illegal in Morocco.
safety.es: Las relaciones sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Marruecos.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual relations are illegal in Morocco.

safety.en: Morocco has a zero-tolerance approach towards drugs.
safety.es: Marruecos tiene una política de tolerancia cero frente a las drogas.
safety.quote: Morocco has a zero-tolerance approach towards drugs.

health.en: Public health facilities in Morocco provide limited care, while private clinics operate to a higher standard.
health.es: Los centros de salud públicos en Marruecos ofrecen atención limitada, mientras que las clínicas privadas operan con un estándar más alto.
health.quote: Public health facilities in Morocco provide limited medical care. Private clinics are available and operate to a higher standard.

health.en: Rabies and other animal-borne diseases are present in Morocco.
health.es: La rabia y otras enfermedades transmitidas por animales están presentes en Marruecos.
health.quote: Rabies and other animal-borne diseases are present in Morocco.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Morocco.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Marruecos.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Morocco.

health.en: Pharmacies are open 24 hours in every city and district.
health.es: Las farmacias abren las 24 horas en todas las ciudades y distritos.
health.quote: Pharmacies are open 24 hours in every city and district.

health.en: It is advisable to drink bottled water and check that the cap is sealed.
health.es: Se aconseja beber agua embotellada y comprobar que el tapón esté sellado.
health.quote: It is advisable to drink bottled water (check that the cap is sealed - some people might try to sell you tap water in recycled bottles).

health.en: No particular inoculations are needed for Morocco under normal circumstances.
health.es: En circunstancias normales no se necesitan vacunas particulares para Marruecos.
health.quote: No particular inoculations are needed for Morocco under normal circumstances

help.en: Emergency numbers are 150 for ambulance and fire, 190 for police and 177 for the gendarmerie.
help.es: Números de emergencia: 150 ambulancia y bomberos, 190 policía y 177 gendarmería.

getting_in.en: Major airlines serving Morocco would most likely land at Casablanca.
getting_in.es: Las principales aerolíneas que sirven a Marruecos probablemente aterrizan en Casablanca.
getting_in.quote: Major airlines that serve Morocco would most likely be landing at Casablanca.

getting_in.en: Other popular entry points are Marrakesh, Agadir, Fes, Rabat and Tangier, served by many European low-cost carriers.
getting_in.es: Otros puntos de entrada populares son Marrakech, Agadir, Fez, Rabat y Tánger, con vuelos de muchas aerolíneas europeas de bajo costo.
getting_in.quote: Other popular entry points include Marrakesh, Agadir, Fes, Rabat, and Tangier, to which many European low-cost carriers fly either year-round or seasonally.

getting_in.en: You can enter by ferry or via the only two open land border posts, connected to the Spanish enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla.
getting_in.es: Puedes entrar en ferry o por los dos únicos pasos fronterizos terrestres abiertos, conectados con los enclaves españoles de Ceuta y Melilla.
getting_in.quote: You can enter via ferry or via the two only open border posts on land connected to the Spanish enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla.

getting_in.en: The frontier with Algeria has been closed since 1994.
getting_in.es: La frontera con Argelia está cerrada desde 1994.
getting_in.quote: The frontier with Algeria has been closed since 1994.

getting_in.en: Tarifa has a ferry service to Tangier, the shortest and fastest route at 35 minutes.
getting_in.es: Tarifa tiene un servicio de ferry a Tánger, la ruta más corta y rápida, de 35 minutos.
getting_in.quote: Tarifa has a similar service to Tangier and this is the shortest and fastest route, just 35 minutes.

getting_in.en: Make sure your ticket goes to the right port, since Tanger Med port is 50 km from Tangier city.
getting_in.es: Asegúrate de que tu boleto vaya al puerto correcto, ya que el puerto de Tanger Med está a 50 km de la ciudad de Tánger.
getting_in.quote: Ensure your ticket takes you to the right port, as for instance 1 Tanger Med port is 50 km from Tangier city.

getting_around.en: Trains are generally the best option because of their speed, frequency and comfort.
getting_around.es: Los trenes suelen ser la mejor opción por su rapidez, frecuencia y comodidad.
getting_around.quote: Trains are generally the best option because of their speed, frequency and comfort.

getting_around.en: Trains between Tangier and Casablanca take about 2 hours 20 minutes.
getting_around.es: Los trenes entre Tánger y Casablanca tardan unas 2 horas y 20 minutos.
getting_around.quote: Between Tangier and Casablanca, trains take about 2 hours 20 minutes to complete the journey.

getting_around.en: Buy train tickets directly from ONCF, since third parties such as Train Ninja or 12go have a substantial mark-up.
getting_around.es: Compra los boletos de tren directamente a ONCF, ya que terceros como Train Ninja o 12go tienen un recargo considerable.
getting_around.quote: Make sure you buy your train tickets directly from ONCF, and not a third party such as Train Ninja or 12go which have a substantial mark-up.

getting_around.en: You can hail a taxi or private car with Careem, Heetch, Roby and InDrive, and Uber stopped operating in Morocco in 2018.
getting_around.es: Puedes pedir un taxi o auto privado con Careem, Heetch, Roby e InDrive, y Uber dejó de operar en Marruecos en 2018.
getting_around.quote: You can hail a taxi or private car with the apps of Careem, Heetch, Roby and InDrive. Uber stopped operations in Morocco in 2018

getting_around.en: Petit taxi prices are reasonable and taxis in town should by law have a meter, although it is not always on.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de los petit taxis son razonables y por ley los taxis urbanos deben tener taxímetro, aunque no siempre lo encienden.
getting_around.quote: Prices for petit taxi are reasonable, and it's the law that taxis in town should have a meter—although they are not always on.

getting_around.en: At large bus stations you should always buy your ticket at the ticket window inside the station.
getting_around.es: En las grandes estaciones de autobuses conviene comprar siempre el boleto en la taquilla dentro de la estación.
getting_around.quote: At the large bus stations (Gare Routière), always buy your ticket at the ticket window inside of the bus station.

money.en: The dirham is the only officially accepted currency, though some hotels may unofficially accept euros and US dollars.
money.es: El dirham es la única moneda aceptada oficialmente, aunque algunos hoteles pueden aceptar euros y dólares de forma extraoficial.
money.quote: While the dirham is the only currency officially accepted in Morocco, some hotels may accept your euros and US dollars unofficially.

money.en: It is illegal to take more than 2,000 dirham out of the country.
money.es: Es ilegal sacar del país más de 2.000 dirhams.
money.quote: It is illegal to take more than 2,000 dirham of local currency out of the country, so you can't buy dirham outside of Morocco.

money.en: Check that an ATM accepts foreign cards, looking for the Maestro, Cirrus or Plus logos, before inserting your card.
money.es: Comprueba que el cajero acepte tarjetas extranjeras, buscando los logos Maestro, Cirrus o Plus, antes de introducir tu tarjeta.
money.quote: Make sure that the ATM accepts foreign cards (look for the Maestro, Cirrus or Plus logos) before you put your card in.

money.en: ATMs are not refilled during weekends in smaller towns, so get enough cash for the weekend on Friday or Saturday morning.
money.es: Los cajeros no se rellenan los fines de semana en pueblos pequeños, así que saca suficiente efectivo el viernes o el sábado por la mañana.
money.quote: Also be aware that they are not refilled during weekends in smaller towns, so get enough cash for the weekend on Friday or Saturday morning.

money.en: Try to carry many small notes, since even accommodations tend not to have change ready.
money.es: Intenta llevar muchos billetes pequeños, ya que incluso los alojamientos suelen no tener cambio.
money.quote: Try to have as many small notes as possible, even accommodations tend to never have any change ready.

money.en: Bargaining in the souks is expected.
money.es: En los zocos se espera que regatees.
money.quote: Remember that bargaining in the souks is expected.

etiquette.en: When visiting a mosque, dress conservatively and remove your shoes before entering.
etiquette.es: Al visitar una mezquita, viste de forma conservadora y quítate los zapatos antes de entrar.
etiquette.quote: If visiting a mosque, for example, be sure to be dressed conservatively and remove your shoes before entering it.

etiquette.en: The left hand is considered unhygienic, so avoid shaking hands or accepting things with it.
etiquette.es: La mano izquierda se considera antihigiénica, así que evita dar la mano o recibir cosas con ella.
etiquette.quote: The left hand is considered unhygienic. Try not to shake hands or accept something from someone with your left hand as it is considered impolite.

etiquette.en: Public displays of affection aren't socially accepted and people can get arrested for them.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto no son socialmente aceptadas y la gente puede ser arrestada por ello.
etiquette.quote: Public displays of affection aren't socially accepted. People can get arrested for doing this.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking and chewing in public.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán debes abstenerte de comer, beber, fumar y masticar en público.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan, you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking, and chewing in public.

etiquette.en: Insulting or speaking out against the Moroccan royal family is punishable by up to five years of imprisonment.
etiquette.es: Insultar a la familia real marroquí o hablar en su contra se castiga con hasta cinco años de prisión.
etiquette.quote: insulting, making fun of them, questioning their rule (this also includes advocating for republicanism), or speaking out against them is punishable by up to five years of imprisonment.

etiquette.en: When greeting someone you don't know, say "Salaam Alaykum" (peace upon you), the standard formal greeting.
etiquette.es: Al saludar a alguien que no conoces, di "Salaam Alaykum" (la paz sea contigo), el saludo formal estándar.
etiquette.quote: When greeting someone you don't know, always say "Salaam Alaykum" ("peace upon you"), which is the standard, formal greeting.

connectivity.en: The major mobile operators in Morocco are Orange, Inwi and Maroc Telecom.
connectivity.es: Los principales operadores móviles en Marruecos son Orange, Inwi y Maroc Telecom.
connectivity.quote: The mobile telephone network in Morocco can be accessed via one of the major operators: Orange, Inwi or Maroc Telecom

connectivity.en: Roaming with international cards from most countries is very expensive, so consider buying a local card.
connectivity.es: El roaming con tarjetas internacionales de la mayoría de países es muy caro, así que considera comprar una tarjeta local.
connectivity.quote: Beware that roaming with international cards from most countries is very expensive, so think about buying a local card.

connectivity.en: SIM cards can be purchased, though some vendors require ID, and the fee paid is credited to the account.
connectivity.es: Se pueden comprar tarjetas SIM, aunque algunos vendedores piden identificación, y el importe pagado se acredita a la cuenta.
connectivity.quote: SIM cards can be purchased, though some vendors require an ID; the card itself is free, the fee paid is credited to the account.

connectivity.en: eSIM cards can be bought and activated entirely online for compatible phones.
connectivity.es: Las eSIM se pueden comprar y activar totalmente en línea en teléfonos compatibles.
connectivity.quote: eSIM cards are available to purchase and activate entirely online for those phones which are compatible.

connectivity.en: SIM cards at some Moroccan international airports are considerably more expensive than elsewhere.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM en algunos aeropuertos internacionales marroquíes son considerablemente más caras que en otros lugares.
connectivity.quote: While you can buy SIM cards at some Moroccan international airports from stalls operated by the major operators, the price is considerably higher than elsewhere

connectivity.en: Almost every restaurant and cafe offers free wifi, usually at acceptable speed.
connectivity.es: Casi todos los restaurantes y cafés ofrecen wifi gratis, normalmente con velocidad aceptable.
connectivity.quote: Almost every restaurant and cafe offers wifi for free with usually acceptable speed.
